title: Better Multiplayer List
description: A mod that improves the multiplayer menu
body:
# Better Multiplayer List
A mod that improves the multiplayer menu.

⚠️ This mod may contain bugs! Please report them on GitHub

## Mod features:
- The ability to add servers to “Favorites”
![Favorite servers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02b5a61cf2f3a35eb2fc9923a4948d21a32f1352.png)
- The ability to create folders for servers
![Folder Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29cda7c598934d2a8352d738bb62645a102e461e_0.webp)
- A server information window
![Info window](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55f48c5a06202f9876a153cd69248ea4e3e0bb60.png)
- The ability to change the IP display mode
![IP display always](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7838f00cbcf20ccfb4a4950c0a24addea2db7b54.png)
![IP display hidden](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b18443a3b3019f24f6aea3c8bb3ecde69c52f2fb.png)
![IP display show on hover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4252e3e9d100f5957152a60ccf2ff160f08759be.png)

## Supported Language:
- English
- Español 
- Русский
- Українська
